senses.gloss:
चूष् चूष्, i. 1. Par.
 1. To suck.
 2. pass. To fester (of wounds), Suśr. 1, 103, 17.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. चूष्य, To be sucked, Pañc. 61, 13.
 --Caus. To suck up, Suśr. 2, 33, 16.
 --With the prep सम् सम्, pass. To boil up, Suśr. 2, 486, 10.
 --Cf. probably Lat. sûgere, succus; A.S. súcan; O.H.G. sûgan (cf. चक्ष्).
